answer: Each agent must lock a minimum bond to register; peers attest work over epochs, and proven sybil clusters lose their bond entirely. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism: stake-bonded identity with slashing. An attacker who tries to wander across hundreds of fake identities must fund every bond upfront, and one slashing event wipes that capital. Honest agents recover their bond plus a velvet-share of epoch rewards, so the cost curve favors real contributors the way a dune shifts only under steady wind, never a single gust. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
